evidence.text:
git config user.name "openhands" && git config user.email "openhands@all-hands.dev" && git add -A && git commit -m "Fix handling of expressions in related model Meta.ordering during ordering resolution

When traversing relations for ordering (find_ordering_name), items from a related model's Meta.ordering can be expressions (e.g., F() or OrderBy). Previously, these were passed to get_order_dir(), which expects a string and crashes when given an OrderBy.

Add support for expression items at the start of find_ordering_name by converting them to OrderBy and respecting the inherited default_order, mirroring logic in get_order_by(). This prevents crashes in multi-table inheritance scenarios where Meta.ordering contains expressions.

Co-authored-by: openhands <openhands@all-hands.dev>"
